## Overview

TVB-O experiments are defined declaratively in YAML. This section documents each specification component:

| Component | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| [Networks](Network.qmd) | Brain network connectivity — regions, weights, tract lengths |
| [Algorithms](Algorithms.qmd) | Built-in iterative tuning algorithms (e.g., FIC) |
| [Loss Functions](LossFunction.qmd) | Symbolic loss functions for optimization |
| [Output](Output.qmd) | Declarative specification of simulation outputs |
